title: RIFT NIF Scene Graph v1
description: Per-NIF scene graph sidecar for RiftFlythrough. One world.json per NIF, recording NiNode transforms, parent-child tree, and NiMesh attachments.

NodeCount.description: Number of NiNode blocks in the NIF

MeshCount.description: Number of NiMesh blocks in the NIF

MeshesAttached.description: Number of NiMesh blocks successfully attached to a parent NiNode

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of scene graph extraction

probe_command.description: Full probe-nif-scene-graph command that produced this output

Nodes.description: All NiNode blocks in block-index order

Meshes.description: All NiMesh blocks with parent-node attachment

BlockIndex.description: NIF block index of this NiNode

Name.description: NiNode name (null or 'SceneNode' for unnamed root)

Translation.description: [x, y, z] translation in local space

Rotation.description: 3x3 rotation matrix flattened row-major [r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33]

ExtraData.description: Extra data refs attached to this node

Children.description: Raw block indices referenced as children (properties, sub-nodes, meshes)

Effects.description: Raw block indices referenced as effects (sub-nodes, meshes)

ChildNodes.description: Resolved child block references with type names

NodeSize.description: Size of the NiNode block in bytes

BlockIndex.description: NIF block index of the child

Size.description: Size of the child block in bytes

BlockIndex.description: NIF block index of this NiMesh

Size.description: Size of the NiMesh block in bytes

ParentNiNodeIndex.description: Block index of the parent NiNode (null if unattached, resolved via Effects list)
